entries.title: Make a link for another computer or a phone from a command
entries.body: On a computer where Infinitary runs with no window, you can now print a one-use link another computer joins with, or a code your phone scans. The link comes from the Infinitary already running there and works once, for ten minutes, as one made in Settings.
entries.noPicture: The link and the phone's code are printed by a command in a terminal, with no change to the app's windows.
